need: Open-licence studies that tabulate both the zero-carbon and the fossil cost of an activity on one basis (Gates's Green Premium), by activity: heating, aviation fuel, cars, trucks, shipping, ammonia, cultivated and plant-based meat; and whether IPCC AR6 WGIII mitigation-cost data are openly licensed. Collected by three helper agents of the green-premium research; publisher sites that blocked scripts (ScienceDirect, cell.com, Wiley, RSC, ACS, IOP, MDPI, Zenodo API) were not worked around: licences were read from the article file itself via Europe PMC / PMC OA, nature.com, or the authors' repository copy of the published version.
notes: IATA's Jet Fuel Price Monitor is Platts data ('Source: © 2026 by (Platts) S&P Global Energy', iata.org/en/publications/economics/fuel-monitor/), so papers whose fossil jet price comes from IATA use Platts for the fossil side.
ICCT's 2023 EU truck total-cost-of-ownership paper carries only '© 2023 INTERNATIONAL COUNCIL ON CLEAN TRANSPORTATION' and 'Content supplied by IHS Markit … All rights reserved.' Not usable.
No open-licence fossil jet-fuel or marine-bunker price was found.

ipcc_ar6_wg3.finding: WGIII figure datasets (SPM.7 costs and potentials in 2030, TS.17 industry cost ranges, SPM.3/TS.7 unit costs, TS.25 investment) are CC BY 4.0 in their catalogue records, but the IPCC Data Catalogue (ipcc-browser.ipcc-data.org) is offline (503/404 on 2026-10-08; last archive capture 2026-05-21) and the copies at ipcc-data.climate.columbia.edu (DOIs 10.7927/5gmb-2w26 and 10.7927/693w-e850, the latter with CC BY 4.0 in its DataCite rights) sit behind a Cloudflare challenge. Chapter figures have no published data. The report text is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (Cambridge) and the IPCC copyright page forbids redistribution and derivatives. SPM.3/TS.7 battery prices are BNEF; TS.25 contains IEA data 'All rights reserved'.
ipcc_ar6_wg3.next_step: A person downloads 10.7927/693w-e850 (and 10.7927/5gmb-2w26) in a browser and records it with envdash snapshot add.
